verdict.rationale: Orrick Tech Studio offers 50+ free forms and document generators with no registration, so non-clients can use them. Specific evidence covers a Convertible Note Financing Term Sheet Creator, a German Incorporation Questionnaire and a term sheet wizard. A community member also reports forming a company with the docs without hiring Orrick. Because NDA templates and SAFE forms are not specifically evidenced, coverage of the story is incomplete. Missing for 10: evidence of NDA templates, evidence of SAFE forms, evidence of US incorporation document sets on the current Tech Studio.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the firm's free public document generators or downloadable startup forms — incorporation documents, SAFEs/term sheets, NDAs — without being a client

citations.quote: With 50+ customizable forms & document generators, 300+ articles, videos and podcasts and robust FAQ and glossary databases, Orrick Tech Studio is our version of open source for the tech & venture ecosystem
It's all free. No registration required.
Convertible Note Financing Term Sheet Creator | Orrick Tech Studio
I used these docs in 2010 to form my company. Even though I used Orrick to create these docs, I did not hire them when it was time for a lawyer.
They also have wizards like the term sheet generator (tsc.orrick.com).
